summary: This table presents the quarterly financial performance across various sectors for the periods ending March 31, 2025, December 31, 2024, and March 31, 2024. The sectors include Financial Services, Manufacturing, Retail, Energy, Utilities, Resources & Services, Communication, Hi-Tech, Life Sciences, and Others. The table also shows year-over-year (YoY) growth percentages for each sector, with Financial Services leading at 11.4% reported growth. The total percentage for all sectors is consistently 100% across the periods. Notably, the Hi-Tech sector shows a decline in growth from 8.7% to 7.9%, while the Others category has the lowest values across all periods.
